findings.description: No sibling roadmap item declares depends_on: [ri-01], so the DAG does not guarantee the solo/team vocabulary lands before ownership-map (ri-02) branches on it.
findings.resolution: Recorded in design.md Open Questions; a /refine-roadmap edit is the remedy and is out of scope for this change.

findings.description: install.sh does not ship docs/, so consumer repositories do not receive the guide; installed skill text must cite principle IDs without depending on the file.
findings.resolution: Stated as a non-goal; follow-up candidate for toolkit-consistency (ri-20).

findings.description: The guard test fails on main when a sibling change directory is deleted or renamed without archival (e.g. superseded via /refine-roadmap), even in a PR that does not touch the guide.
findings.resolution: Accepted as the intended drift signal (design Risks); the failure message names the stale change-id.
